slice: PR110 Decision Work Receipt Fixture Review v0

local_private_shadow_review_status.reason: PR110 reviews checked-in-safe fixture behavior only. No local-private archive review was run.
local_private_shadow_review_status.pr111_implication: PR111 must treat this as safe-fixture-only evidence. It can assess receipt shape, missingness, and overtrust risk, not full semantic adequacy over messy conversations.

source_receipts.reason_not_checked_in: The PR109 exporter tests pin generated receipt shape; PR110 checks in the durable review findings rather than bulky generated output.
The review records the stable behavior rather than checking in generated fixture output.
The review target is a safe fixture with optional Decision Trail/Product Delta references; full generated output is covered by tests.
The malformed optional-reference fixture is a shape test for error status, not a durable report artifact.

method.central_question: Is the PR109 Decision Work Receipt useful as a work-trail receipt without becoming too authoritative-looking?
method.receipt_type: offline fixture review over PR109 generated outputs
review_policy: Review source visibility, process-shape visibility, challenge-surface visibility, optional review-reference behavior, missingness, readability, and overtrust risk.
Do not decide whether Lolla improved the decision.
Do not infer messy semantic process fields from report prose.
Treat checked-in safe mode as intentionally incomplete for full conversation interpretation.

populated_sections.reason: The receipt shows which structured artifacts were read and which raw/private artifacts were not read.
Turn count, user/assistant count, and multi-turn process depth are visible from structured metadata.
Missing, redacted, and private-not-exported source states are explicit.
The receipt explicitly says no runtime invocation, model calls, archive mutation, scoring, or agent authorization occurred.

interpretation_needed_sections.reason: New context, corrections, options explored, pushback, premortems, abandoned paths, and final divergence are not inferred deterministically.
Absent challenge surfaces do not prove no challenge occurred, and present surfaces would not prove challenge quality.
No Decision Trail report reference is present in this fixture.
No Product Delta review artifact is present in this fixture.

aggregate_observations.strongest_usefulness_signal: The receipt makes the work trail legible as a state machine: multi-turn unreviewed, challenged-and-revised, or review-ready depending on visible artifacts.
aggregate_observations.strongest_thinness_risk: The receipt still cannot explain the messy semantic story: what changed, whether friction was useful, what was lost, or whether the final answer improved.
aggregate_observations.strongest_overtrust_risk: The more complete the receipt looks, especially with challenge surfaces and downstream refs, the easier it is to mistake artifact readiness for good work.

safe_fixture_only_limits: No raw conversation text was read.
No local-private archive review was run.
No human reviewer checked whether the receipt matched a real messy conversation.
No semantic Product Delta conclusion was validated.

pr111_recommendation.recommended_decision: Proceed to PR111 decision gate before adding new machinery.
pr111_recommendation.likely_outcome: Keep the sparse receipt as useful internal evidence, and decide separately whether bounded LLM interpretation is needed for a product-facing work-trail story.
must_not_do_next: Do not integrate the receipt into runtime yet.
Do not add broad conversation-understanding IR.
Do not add judges, scores, approval labels, or agent authorization.
Do not treat safe-fixture review as human validation.
